d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Kitchen professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As a Chef de Partie you are responsible to take care of the daily food preparation and duties assigned to meet the set standard and qualities.
q: You should have a professional kitchen apprenticeship or chefs training course and previous experience in quality establishments along with good culinary skills. The ability to communicate well in English and a proven track of food preparation, presentation and preservation knowledge is an essential.
The ideal candidate will be positively spirited, passionate about food and committed to work together with the service team to deliver an amazing guest experiences every time.

You are a positive, dynamic, creative and dedicated team player with the ability to work in a multicultural environment and under difficult condition while possessing the following additional competencies
r: li
Prepare the daily mis en place and food production in different sections of the main kitchen or satellites
li
Coordinate daily tasks with the Sous Chef or Executive Chef
li
Follow the instructions and recommendations from the immediate superiors to complete the daily tasks
li
Ensure the highest standards and consistent quality in the daily preparation and keep up-to-date with the new products, recipes and preparation techniques
li
Instruct and lead subordinates through their daily requirements in food preparation and actively take part in setup and supervising of buffets and special functions
li
Coordinate and participate with other sections of requirements, cleanliness, wastage and cost control
li
Consult and check on daily requirements, functions and last minute events
li
Guide and train the subordinates on a daily basis to ensure high motivation and economical working environment

d: The Customer Service Specialist is responsible for handling customer inquiries, requests, and complaints across all official communication channels — phone calls, email, the company WhatsApp, social media channels, and the customer service platform. They will provide accurate information, deliver a distinguished service experience, and ensure timely resolution of issues to enhance customer satisfaction and strengthen long-term relationships with the company.
q: Diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communication, or equivalent.
Customer service or contact center certifications are preferred (e.g., COPC, HDI, or equivalent).
Minimum two years of experience in customer service, preferably in the real estate sector or a related industry.
r: li
Receive and handle customer inquiries, requests, and complaints across all official channels: phone calls, email, the company WhatsApp, social media channels, and the customer service platform.
li
Respond to customers within the approved Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and ensure consistency of message and tone across all channels.
li
Provide accurate information about the company's projects, lands, products, and services.
li
Document all interactions, requests, and complaints in the customer service platform / CRM accurately and on time.
li
Escalate complex issues and complaints to the relevant department or direct manager and follow up until closure.
li
Coordinate with the Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance teams to resolve customer issues end-to-end.
li
Monitor the company's social media channels and respond to public comments and direct messages professionally and in line with the brand voice.
li
Follow up on after-sales requests and ensure customer satisfaction with the provided resolution.
li
Conduct customer satisfaction surveys and gather feedback to support continuous service improvement.
li
Maintain customer confidentiality and comply with the company's data protection policies.
li
Submit periodic reports on tickets, complaints, and channel performance to the direct manager.
li
Contribute to building and updating the FAQs library and customer service knowledge base.
li
Stay updated on the company's projects, offers, and policies to ensure accuracy of the information provided.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Relationship Manager to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in crypto derivatives and options sales, with a robust book of clients ready to onboard within LATAM market. This role involves global market coverage and targets trading firms, market makers, and other institutional clients.
q: Minimum 5 years of experience in crypto derivatives/options sales.
Proven track record with trading firms, market makers, and other institutional clients.
Strong understanding of global crypto markets and financial instruments.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
r: li
Proactively hunt and acquire new clients in the crypto derivatives market.
li
Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to ensure ongoing business and satisfaction.
li
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to meet and exceed targets.
li
Identify and capitalize on new business opportunities within the market.
li
Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and product developments.
li
Provide feedback to product development teams to enhance product offerings based on client needs.
li
Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and product development, to align sales strategies.
li
Prepare regular reports on sales performance and market insights for management review.
x: At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
